mentl/66e231d:
What an IDE is when the program is a graph, text is one projection
among many, and the compiler is the intelligence: the IDE is the
program's own self-projection pointed at a human, and mentl edit is
itself a Mentl program — the language is the plugin API, so every
extension is proven under the same rows as everything else.

The anti-IDE table dissolves each fixture of IDE-land into the kernel
fact it papered over (files, save, run, the error list, breakpoints,
diff review, the chat panel, the plugin marketplace). Five signature
interactions, each a primitive surfacing: fill-and-resume (the hole is
a dormant continuation — the program runs while you write it),
constraint sculpting, the Why walk, reality scrubbing (multi-shot
exploration held as parallel live branches), and the proof surface
(transitive absence proofs as the review for code no human wrote).
Domain projections (DSP scopes, refinement-bounded sliders,
autodiff-as-multishot), sessions-as-images, collaboration as two
cursors on one graph, and the substrate gate per surface — naming why
the multi-shot producer is simultaneously the kernel's TIME axis and
the IDE's soul.

JUSTIFICATION reads more cleanly when the prior landings are
explicit. Captures:

  - heap-uniform allocation pattern: LMakeClosure + LMakeVariant +
    LMakeRecord all share emit_alloc + offset stores; three sites,
    one EmitMemory swap surface (rule of three earned post-H2).
  - LMatch cascade with field binding: H3's emit_pat_field_binds

    LFieldLoad has been waiting for; closes a loop opened earlier.
  - SchemeKind extension pattern: RecordSchemeKind would land if
    nominal records arrive; structural-only v1 doesn't need it,

name_set_*; H2 needs field_set_*. Three instances earn an abstract
ordered-set algebra parametric over (element, key, comparator) —
factoring is its own follow-up post-H5.

Frame consolidation (Ω.5) becomes mechanical AFTER H2.2 (functional
update). The full chain H2 → H2.2 → Ω.5 — three small commits.

Single-variant ADTs ARE records — Mentl's H5 catalog gains the
gradient candidate "this single-variant ADT could be a record"
with a precise refactor and a precise win (4 bytes/instance + named
field access).

Records as handler state (post-cascade enhancement) and as the
AuditReport substrate (H5) — both natural projections of H2's
landing, surfaced now so they're not forgotten when their phase
arrives.

Recap table maps what each prior handle / phase contributes to H2,
making the riffle-back explicit.

clob/6670b2f:
find_program enumerated |primitives|^depth candidate programs and fully
materialized each one via depth-many d^3 ternary matmuls. At the d=16
of its tests that is cheap, as the module comment claimed; at d=128 it
is ~21^4 candidates x ~8M ops each, on the order of 10^12 operations.
The bug stayed latent for the project's whole life because no real run
had ever crystallized a module -- the first one to exist hung the
crystal subcommand for over ten minutes.

The structural fact that fixes it: every DSL primitive (identity,
shift, negate, reverse, mask) is a signed partial permutation -- at
most one nonzero per row -- and that shape is closed under matrix
product. The DSL's closure is exactly the signed-partial-permutation
monoid. Two consequences:

- A target with two or more nonzeros in any row is provably outside
  the closure. One O(d^2) scan rejects it with no search at all. Real
  crystallized modules (rank-1 ternarized corrections) hit this gate
  essentially always.
- The search itself runs over O(d) row maps with a visited-set, BFS by
  program length over distinct reachable matrices instead of raw op
  tuples. Shifts compose additively, negate and reverse are
  involutions, masks are idempotent, so the deduplicated frontier
  stays tiny.

Behavior is preserved: BFS still returns a shortest program, reachable
targets are still found (new deep_composition_found_at_scale test pins
a depth-3 composition at d=128), unreachable ones still return None. A
new row_map_composition_matches_matrix_composition test pins the O(d)
path to the O(d^3) semantics on every primitive pair. The test suite
drops from 3.2s to 0.06s -- the old synth tests were paying the same
materialization tax.
